title: TruthLens: A Verification-Gated Pipeline for Evidence-Grounded Fact-Checking of Short-Form Political Video
description:
Source code for TruthLens, an evidence-first pipeline for fact-checking short-form political video and image posts. The pipeline decomposes a post into atomic claims, researches each against the open web, and subjects every generated verdict to a deterministic, non-LLM validator before publication.

This software record accompanies the preprint and the TruthLens-202 evaluation corpus. The default configuration runs entirely on local models (Ollama, faster-whisper) with no API key and no per-token cost.

Status: preprint and research code. Not peer reviewed.
